description:
We are looking for a dynamic, enthusiastic, and creative individual who enjoys working in an Agile environment. - Must have 5 years of hands-on experience programming in Oracle PL/SQL to design database procedures functions, packages, types, indexes, and triggers - Perform design, coding, testing, implementation, and documentation - Apply database programming skills to design, construct, and test relational databases - Implement normalized database models - Creating physical design in support of functional requirements - Resolve data integration and performance issues - Possess a thorough understanding of the data, sources of data, and relationships of data - Create data migration, data import, data export routines - Strong Knowledge in Creating Stored Procedures & functions - Write database DDL and DML scripts - Design database access controls - Ability to design and develop workflows - Conduct change impact analysis - Solid database and operating system systems knowledge in Oracle


 Additional Info:
 Must be able to pass a background and drug screen
